test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A can do a piece of work in 60 days. He works at it for 15 days, and then B alone finishes the remaining work in 30 days. In how many days can A and B working together finish the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work = 60 days

Number of days A works = 15 days

B alone finish the remaining work = 30 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = (60/15) = 4 days

Number of days B works = (1 – 1/4) = 3/4 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = (4/3 × 30) = 40 days

Now,

LCM of 60 and 40 is 120

Efficiency of A = (120/60) = 2 units/day
